result.instructions: Tools for Jostle, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Show me the title, due date and assignee of task 12345."; "Create a task for sam.k to review the holiday rota, due 4 December 2026."; "Add a comment to task 12345 saying the supplier invoice is approved.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Jostle data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run jostle_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run jostle_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run jostle_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. jostle_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: jostle_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List the users in the Jostle instance with their id, username and display name. Use the id or username when you create or update a task. Jostle API: GET /v2/people.

tools.name: jostle_list_presets
tools.title: List presets
tools.description: List the Jostle list presets (named groups of users for assignees or collaborators). Use a preset id when you create a task. Jostle API: GET /v2/people/list-presets.

tools.name: jostle_get_task
tools.title: Get a task
tools.description: Get one task by id: title, description, due date, assignee, collaborators, completion status and comment count. The token user must be the assignee or a collaborator. Jostle API: GET /v2/tasks/task/{id}.

tools.name: jostle_list_task_comments
tools.title: List task comments
tools.description: List the comments on a task, newest page first, with paging. Jostle API: GET /v2/tasks/task/{id}/comments.

tools.name: jostle_create_task
tools.title: Create a task
tools.description: Create a task in the Tasks of one assignee. Give the assignee as userId, username or employeeId, and optional collaborators or a preset. Due dates are saved in Eastern Standard Time. Jostle API: POST /v2/tasks.

employeeId.description: Employee id (external id) of the user.

assignee.description: A user, given by id, username or employee id.

employeeId.description: Employee id (external id) of the user.

items.description: A user, given by id, username or employee id.

tools.name: jostle_update_task
tools.title: Update a task
tools.description: Change a task with JSON Patch operations (RFC 6902). Allowed paths: /title, /description, /dueDate, /assignee, /collaborators, /completionStatus. Jostle API: PATCH /v2/tasks/task/{id}.

value.description: The new value (not needed for remove).

operations.description: The patch operations to apply, in order.

tools.name: jostle_add_task_comment
tools.title: Comment on a task
tools.description: Add a comment to a task as the token user. Comments are visible to everyone who can see the task. Jostle API: POST /v2/tasks/task/{id}/comment.
